newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Electricar stake held by Hyundai.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Electricar stake held by Hyundai.

text.p: Hyundai Electronic Industries Co Ltd and Hyundai Motor Co said Monday they hold an 8.4 percent stake in U.S. Electricar Inc or 12 million common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the two Hyundais said the purchase was in connection with a February 27 agreement which called for Hyundai Electronics and Hyundai Motor to invest $3.6 million in the firm.
The purpose of the acquisition of the purchased shares is for investment, the filing said.

San Francisco, Calif.,-based U.S. Electricar, develops and manufactures electric vehicles internationally and in the U.S., with products ranging from converted sedans and light trucks to transit buses and other commercial vehicles.
